simp_chinese.origin_heart_of_devouring_desc: 我们的文明从未把星球视作疆界。它们只是尚未剥离的食物。女王·白绮以冰冷的意志统御族群：异族、生命与整个世界，最终都将归入唯一的王座。
simp_chinese.origin_heart_of_devouring_effects:
§Y需要Nemesis。仅限灭绝国策。§!新游戏开局直接获得§R化身天灾§!，保留灵能等种族飞升的原版准入。王座岗位产出基础§G+10%§!，武灾每阶段再加§G10个百分点§!（阶段1～5为20%～60%，最迟下月同步）。
开局母星额外1条并行民用建造队列，获得配备遗迹级无畏战舰配置、真实跃迁和暗物质动力的母舰及10条移动船坞。蜂巢／机械智能／其它政体分别获得蜂巢星球／机械星球／遗落星球母星，不额外赠送殖民地。母舰每吞噬10单位有效物质升一级，等级无上限；每级伤害、舰体、装甲、护盾各+5%。饕餮解构光束可直接拆解交战敌国殖民星，收益归母星，无需陆军。
母星初始额外区划容量§G+2§!。吞噬自有自然殖民地，回迁合格本族人口；累计每§Y4§!格原生物质增加§G1§!母星区划。通用拆解每累计§Y6§!格制造§G100§!本族人口；噬岩者保留原版随机收益。通常15～25格星球耗时3～5年，区划使用正常岗位。
殖民管理入口使用决议：觐见女王、迁移母星、取消拆解、自动吞噬开关与单星豁免恢复。自动吞噬§Y默认关闭§!；迁移后旧母星也可能被自动吞噬。旧存档不追补开局奖励或危机路线。
simp_chinese.eep_requires_exterminator: 需要吞噬蜂群、铁心灭绝者、种族洁癖或焦土灭绝国策。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_devour_desc: 白绮不承认异族对星球的任何权利。留下足够的本族消化者，把人口、地壳与熔融核心逐一收归母星。
simp_chinese.eep_devour_effect: 消化耗时为剩余原生物质 Q × 2.4 月，向上取整。结算时回迁合格本族人口，源星永久破碎。容量按累计 Q 每 4 格兑换；通用拆解人口按累计 Q 每 6 格制造 100，余料跨星保留。噬岩者使用原版随机消费收益。母星失联或战斗期间暂停；末期等待原版肃清结束。
simp_chinese.eep_source_required: 需要自有、和平、非母星的自然殖民地，包括蜂巢星球和机械星球；母星必须仍由本国控制。不能吞噬巨构、方舟、环段、突触凝练器或纳米世界。
simp_chinese.eep_seed_required: 源星需有至少 100 非肃清本族人口，或母星有超过 100 的本族人口供补足差额；不得迁走母星最后一批人口。消化者不免费生成。
simp_chinese.eep_material_required: 需要尚未损毁的原生物质。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_audience_desc: 走入吞噬之心的王庭。白绮审视的是归还王座的物质和下一颗即将毁灭的星球。
simp_chinese.eep_audience_effect: 查看绑定母星、累计物质、人口制造、活动任务和真实飞升状态。报告只读，不发放奖励。
simp_chinese.eep_capacity_desc: 吞噬所得物质成为真实可建区划容量；星球原始尺寸不变。
simp_chinese.d_eep_core_desc: 女王的意志汇聚于此。王座加成与累积区划容量可通过决议随母星迁移；王庭加成仅在本国控制绑定母星时生效。失去母星不会自行选择替代王座。
simp_chinese.situation_eep_devouring_desc: 没有生命值得保留，没有地壳值得浪费。[Target.GetName] 将被消化，最终成为唯一母星的一部分。
simp_chinese.situation_eep_devouring_monthly_change_t: 每个有效推进月增加 1 进度。母星失联、源星占领或地面战暂停。完成后若肃清仍在进行，则等待最后一批异族消失。
simp_chinese.eep_digesting_desc: 把这颗星球的一切用途归结为供养王座。
simp_chinese.eep_devour_approach_desc: 继续消化直到世界破碎。
simp_chinese.eep_cancel_approach_desc: 中止本星球拆解并使其免于自动重开。不返还已经付出的种子迁移或原生噬岩代价，不发放收益；可通过恢复决议或手动开始解除豁免。
simp_chinese.eep_block_core: 王座失联：绑定母星不在本国控制下。吞噬与结算暂停，收复同一母星后恢复。
simp_chinese.eep_block_combat: 消化站处于占领或地面战，推进暂停。
simp_chinese.eep_block_purge: 物质消化已完成；等待原版肃清结束，不提前毁灭人口或重复消费。
simp_chinese.eep.10.name: 唯一的王座
simp_chinese.eep.10.desc:
白绮立于母星的黑曜石王庭，垂眼望着星图。

‘疆界？’她的声音毫无温度。‘我不需要为食物划定疆界。’

没有对异族的许诺，没有怜悯，更没有退路。族群的一切必须供养这颗心脏。被征服的世界将交出自己的生命、地壳与核心，而女王不会为其中任何一样感到惋惜。
simp_chinese.eep.11.name: 一颗世界的余烬
simp_chinese.eep.11.desc:
最后一层地壳从消化站剥离。曾经的海洋和城市不再拥有名字，只有归还母星的物质数量。

白绮扫过报告，神情甚至没有一丝愉悦。‘下一个。’

已吞噬世界：[Root.eep_worlds]；累计原生物质：[Root.eep_c]；母星新增容量：[Root.eep_d]；通用拆解制造人口：[Root.eep_made]。这些数字记录既成结算，本次消息不追加奖励。

王庭：[Root.GetEEPCourtStage]。最近一颗世界：新增容量 [Root.eep_last_capacity]；回迁本族 [Root.eep_last_return]；通用制造 [Root.eep_last_manufactured]。
simp_chinese.eep.13.name: [Root.GetEEPCourtStage]
simp_chinese.eep.13.desc:
母星的地平线再一次延伸。新区划承接真正的住房和岗位，工厂、巢室与神经中枢继续运转。

白绮以指尖掠过星图，把一片异族疆域从未来中抹去。‘他们所谓的故土，只是我们的下一层地基。’

累计物质：[Root.eep_c]；额外总容量：[Root.eep_d]；已制造人口：[Root.eep_made]。女王记录新的成长阶段，不赠予第二份经济收益。
simp_chinese.eep.30.name: 不可抗拒的意志
simp_chinese.eep.30.desc:
我们的合法灵能飞升已完成。王庭的意识贯穿母星；灵能协调与普通岗位共同支撑这颗不断膨胀的心脏。

白绮俯视虚境中的异族回声，像审视一份毫无价值的残渣。‘不必理解他们。只需让他们服从终局。’

这一刻记录已经取得的原版飞升能力。女王没有赐予额外人口、区划或飞升资格。
simp_chinese.eep.31.name: 以群星铸成刀锋
simp_chinese.eep.31.desc:
我们的天灾进程已实际解锁矿物舰。吞噬所得矿物进入舰队，合金继续供养母星建设；两条生产链在战争中闭合。

白绮望着舰队从王庭上空驶过。‘损失可以补充。迟疑不被允许。’

矿物舰的可用性、成本和后续阶段均沿用原版。女王不会越过 DLC、飞升或特殊项目的条件。
simp_chinese.eep.31.a: 让刀锋指向下一颗星球。
simp_chinese.eep.40.name: 王座失联
simp_chinese.eep.40.desc:
绑定母星的控制权已经中断。吞噬局势停在原处，所有尚未结算的收益被封存。

白绮的指令冰冷而直接：‘夺回来。代价不在考虑之内。’

收复同一颗母星后任务恢复。迁都不能制造第二颗吞噬之心。
simp_chinese.eep.41.name: 王座复归
simp_chinese.eep.41.desc:
原始母星重新回到族群控制之下。尚存的消化站恢复推进，等待结算的任务仍按各自凭证兑现一次。

白绮没有庆贺。‘继续。让他们为这段耽搁付出一切。’
simp_chinese.eep.42.name: 心脏的终止
simp_chinese.eep.42.desc:
原始母星已经不再是可用殖民地。吞噬之心没有备用王座。

未完成任务将终止；不会重绑首都、复制容量或补发人口。幸存殖民地继续沿用原版规则经营。白绮留下的最后指令，依旧没有给怜悯留下位置。
simp_chinese.eep.100.name: 女王·白绮：王庭账簿
simp_chinese.eep.100.desc:
‘我只看已经归还王座的东西。’

simp_chinese.eep.101.name: 消化站：[eep_report_source.GetName]
simp_chinese.eep.101.desc:
‘毁灭不是借口。把进度交代清楚。’

源星：[eep_report_source.GetName]
路径：[eep_report_source.GetEEPTaskPath]

simp_chinese.eep_path_generic: 通用拆解：累计物质制造人口
simp_chinese.eep.32.name: 王庭的下一柄刀锋
simp_chinese.eep.32.desc:
白绮审视新近解锁的舰型。‘他们的反抗，必须比上一颗世界更短。’

实际武灾阶段：[Root.eep_crisis]。阶段 3 解锁 $crisis_destroyer$，阶段 4 解锁 $crisis_cruiser$；船型、装配和维护沿用原版，此消息不授予能力或奖励。
simp_chinese.eep_court_desc: 女王的王座提高母星岗位产出：基础+10%，化身天灾每个原生武灾阶段再加10个百分点。阶段1～5分别为20%／30%／40%／50%／60%，最迟下月同步；随王座迁移。没有武灾的旧存档保持基础10%。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_digest_report_desc: 呈上这颗星球的剥离进度。白绮只关心它还有多少价值尚未归入王座。
simp_chinese.eep_digest_report_effect: 查看本星球的吞噬进度、暂停原因与待结算状态。报告不发放奖励。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_auto_devour_enable_desc: 女王的命令：除唯一母星外，将帝国所有合格殖民地纳入吞噬。新取得的殖民地也将受到此命令约束。
simp_chinese.eep_auto_devour_enable_effect: 开启全帝国开关。每月自动启动自有、非母星且符合吞噬条件的星球；沿用本族种子、和平与母星绑定限制。默认关闭；巨构与其它不合格对象跳过。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_auto_devour_disable_desc: 暂缓王座的扩张命令，由你逐颗决定星球的命运。
simp_chinese.eep_auto_devour_disable_effect: 关闭全帝国开关，不再自动启动新任务。已经开始的吞噬继续；如需中止，请在源星执行取消本星球拆解决议，或在对应局势中选择中止消化。
simp_chinese.eep_parallel_construction_desc: 女王命令当前绑定母星同时推进额外一项民用建造。仅由本国控制时生效，随王座迁移。
simp_chinese.eep_mothership_desc: 采用遗迹级无畏战舰的武器、防御与核心科技，配备真实跃迁引擎、暗物质动力和十条移动船坞。每吞噬10单位物质进化一级，无上限；实际数值受帝国修正影响。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_migrate_core_desc: 白绮的意志不依附于泥土。将这里确立为新的母星，让王座与帝国首都一同迁来。
simp_chinese.eep_migration_required: 当前母星必须仍由本国正常控制；目标须为自有、未被占领且无地面战斗的合格殖民地，不能正在吞噬、属于人工天体或承载另一座王座。
simp_chinese.eep_migration_effect: 将母星绑定、帝国首都、王座岗位加成、累积区划容量与已授予的额外并行建造队列转移至此。不搬运人口或建筑，不改变库存及吞噬账本。其它拆解任务继续，收益送往新母星。§R若全帝国自动吞噬已开启，旧母星之后也可能被自动拆解。§!
simp_chinese.decision_eep_cancel_devour_desc: 撤回对这颗星球的拆解命令。女王容许一次改令，却不会替你抹去已经付出的代价。
simp_chinese.eep_cancel_devour_effect: 立即中止本星球的吞噬局势并解除本Mod的拆解锁，不发放收益。已经迁移的种子人口和原生噬岩损伤不会撤回。本星球获得自动吞噬豁免，防止下月重开；可通过恢复决议或手动开始解除。其它任务与全帝国开关保持。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_resume_auto_devour_desc: 撤销这颗星球的临时赦免，令它再次服从帝国的吞噬命令。
simp_chinese.eep_resume_auto_devour_effect: 仅解除本星球的自动吞噬豁免。全帝国自动吞噬开启时，下一次月度扫描会按正常条件尝试启动；关闭时仍需手动开始。
simp_chinese.EEP_PLANET_KILLER_DEVOURER_DESC: 将天然殖民星拆解并献于母星，无需陆军。只能用于自有非母星或交战敌国殖民星；完成发射时按有效规模结算容量、人口和母舰成长。普通拆解每6单位制造100本族人口，噬岩者保留原生随机收益。取消发射不发奖励。
simp_chinese.eep_colossus_target_required: 需要本国母舰、可用母星，以及有效物质大于0的自有非核心或交战敌国天然殖民星。不能攻击任何帝国的母星核心、人工天体、殖民中、地面战斗中、正在吞噬或已经结算的星球。
simp_chinese.eep_mothership_evolution_desc: 每累计吞噬10单位有效物质进化一级，不设上限。每级额外伤害、舰体、装甲、护盾各+5%，舰体与装甲每日恢复各+0.1。
simp_chinese.eep_evolution_report: 母舰进化等级：[Root.eep_mothership_level]；距离下一级：[Root.eep_mothership_next] 单位物质。每级伤害、舰体、装甲、护盾各+5%；每10单位进化，等级无上限。$eep_component_report$
simp_chinese.EEP_ADAPTIVE_SHIELD_CORE_DESC: 每层护盾+10%。每进化5级，从六种核心等概率随机选择一个升级一层，升级永久保留。本核心不额外消耗供能或维护资源。
simp_chinese.EEP_ADAPTIVE_ARMOR_CORE_DESC: 每层装甲+10%。每进化5级，从六种核心等概率随机选择一个升级一层，升级永久保留。本核心不额外消耗供能或维护资源。
simp_chinese.EEP_ADAPTIVE_HULL_CORE_DESC: 每层舰体+10%。每进化5级，从六种核心等概率随机选择一个升级一层，升级永久保留。本核心不额外消耗供能或维护资源。
simp_chinese.EEP_ADAPTIVE_DAMAGE_CORE_DESC: 每层武器伤害+5%。每进化5级，从六种核心等概率随机选择一个升级一层，升级永久保留。本核心不额外消耗供能或维护资源。
simp_chinese.EEP_ADAPTIVE_TRACKING_CORE_DESC: 每层索敌+3点。每进化5级，从六种核心等概率随机选择一个升级一层，升级永久保留。本核心不额外消耗供能或维护资源。
simp_chinese.EEP_ADAPTIVE_REGEN_CORE_DESC: 每层舰体与装甲固定日恢复各+0.2。每进化5级，从六种核心等概率随机选择一个升级一层，升级永久保留。本核心不额外消耗供能或维护资源。
simp_chinese.eep_component_report:
§H核心升级记录§!
应得：[Root.eep_component_entitled]；已发：[Root.eep_component_rewards]；待补：[Root.eep_component_pending]
最近确认层数：护盾 [Root.eep_component_shield_level]／装甲 [Root.eep_component_armor_level]／舰体 [Root.eep_component_hull_level]／火力 [Root.eep_component_damage_level]／索敌 [Root.eep_component_tracking_level]／再生 [Root.eep_component_regen_level]。
每五级随机永久升级六种核心之一；大量积压会分批补发。母舰损毁或不可用时停止升级，保留历史记录；历史记录不代表现役组件。尚无记录时显示0。

english.origin_heart_of_devouring_desc: Our civilization never regarded worlds as borders. They are food yet to be stripped bare. Queen Vivhite rules with an icy will: alien lives and entire planets will eventually belong to the only throne.
english.origin_heart_of_devouring_effects:
§YRequires Nemesis. Extermination civics only.§! New games immediately grant §RBecome the Crisis§!, retaining vanilla eligibility for species ascensions such as psionics. Throne job output starts at §G+10%§!, plus §G10 percentage points§! per native Nemesis crisis level (20%–60% at levels 1–5, synchronized by the next monthly update).
Start with one extra parallel civilian construction queue on the homeworld and a mothership with Relic-class dreadnought equipment, a working jump drive, dark matter propulsion and ten mobile shipyards. Hive Minds, Machine Intelligences and other authorities receive a Hive World, Machine World or Relic World homeworld respectively, without an extra colony. The mothership gains one uncapped level per 10 effective matter consumed; each level adds +5% damage, hull, armor and shields. Its Voracious Deconstruction Beam dismantles wartime enemy colonies for the homeworld without armies.
The homeworld starts with §G+2§! district capacity. Devour owned natural colonies and return eligible founder population; every cumulative §Y4§! native matter adds §G1§! homeworld district. Generic dismantling creates §G100§! population per cumulative §Y6§! matter; Terravores retain native random rewards. Typical size 15–25 worlds take 3–5 years and districts use normal jobs.
Colonial decisions provide the Queen's audience, homeworld relocation, dismantling cancellation, automatic-devouring switches and local exemption removal. Automatic devouring is §Ydisabled by default§!; after relocation the former homeworld may also be devoured automatically. Existing saves receive no retroactive startup rewards or crisis path.
english.eep_requires_exterminator: Requires Devouring Swarm, Determined Exterminator, Fanatic Purifiers, or an extermination scorched-earth civic.
english.decision_eep_devour: Devour: Offer to the Only Throne
english.decision_eep_devour_desc: Vivhite recognizes no alien claim to a world. Leave enough founder population to digest it, then bring its inhabitants, crust and molten core home.
english.eep_devour_effect: Digestion takes Q × 2.4 effective months, rounded up. Completion returns eligible founder population and permanently shatters the source. Capacity is exchanged per cumulative 4 Q; generic dismantling creates 100 population per cumulative 6 Q, carrying remainders across worlds. Terravores retain native random consumption rewards. Core loss or combat pauses progress; final settlement waits for vanilla purging to end.
english.eep_source_required: Requires an owned, peaceful natural colony other than the bound core, including Hive Worlds and Machine Worlds, with the core under our control. Megastructures, arks, ring segments, the Synaptic Lathe and nanotech worlds are excluded.
english.eep_seed_required: The source needs at least 100 non-purging founder population, or the core needs more than 100 to supply the shortfall. Never relocate the core’s last population. Digestion workers are not created for free.
english.decision_eep_audience_desc: Enter the court of the Heart of Devouring. Vivhite judges the matter returned to her throne and the next world marked for destruction.
english.eep_audience_effect: Read the bound core, cumulative matter, population manufacturing, active tasks and actual ascension status. This report grants no rewards.
english.eep_capacity: Heart of Devouring: Accumulated World Matter
english.eep_capacity_desc: Devoured matter becomes genuine buildable district capacity without changing the planet's original size.
english.d_eep_core_desc: The Queen's will converges here. Throne bonuses and accumulated district capacity can follow a homeworld relocation decision. Court bonuses apply only while we control the bound homeworld; losing it never selects a replacement throne automatically.
english.situation_eep_devouring_desc: No life deserves preservation. No crust deserves waste. [Target.GetName] will become part of the only homeworld.
english.situation_eep_devouring_monthly_change_t: Gain 1 progress each effective month. Core loss, occupation or ground combat pauses progress. Final settlement waits for all vanilla purging to finish.
english.eep_digesting_desc: Reduce every purpose of this world to feeding the throne.
english.eep_devour_approach_desc: Continue digestion until the world shatters.
english.eep_cancel_approach_desc: Abort this world's dismantling and exempt it from automatic restarts. Existing seed relocation and native Terravore costs are not refunded, and no rewards are granted. A resume decision or successful manual start removes the exemption.
english.eep_block_core: Throne disconnected: the bound core is outside our control. Progress and settlement pause until this same world is recovered.
english.eep_block_combat: The digestion colony is occupied or fighting a ground battle. Progress is paused.
english.eep_block_purge: Digestion is complete. Waiting for vanilla purging to finish; no premature population destruction or repeated consumption.
english.eep.10.name: The Only Throne
english.eep.10.desc:
Vivhite stands in the obsidian court, gazing down at the star chart.

Borders? Her voice carries no warmth. I do not draw borders around food.

There are no promises to aliens, no mercy and no retreat. Everything must feed this heart. Conquered worlds will surrender their lives, crust and cores. The Queen will regret none of it.
english.eep.10.a: Beyond the throne, all may be devoured.
english.eep.11.name: The Ashes of a World
english.eep.11.desc:
The last crust peels away. Oceans and cities have lost their names; only the quantity returned to the core remains.

Vivhite glances at the report without pleasure. Next.

Worlds consumed: [Root.eep_worlds]; cumulative native matter: [Root.eep_c]; added core capacity: [Root.eep_d]; population manufactured by generic dismantling: [Root.eep_made]. These record completed settlement. This message grants no additional reward.

Court: [Root.GetEEPCourtStage]. Latest world: capacity added [Root.eep_last_capacity]; founder population returned [Root.eep_last_return]; generic manufacture [Root.eep_last_manufactured].
english.eep.11.a: Let the ashes feed the heart.
english.eep.13.name: [Root.GetEEPCourtStage]
english.eep.13.desc:
The core's horizon expands again. New districts support real housing and jobs; factories, hive chambers and neural hubs keep working.

Vivhite brushes an alien territory from the star chart. Their ancestral soil is merely our next foundation.

Cumulative matter: [Root.eep_c]; total bonus capacity: [Root.eep_d]; manufactured population: [Root.eep_made]. The Queen records a new growth stage without a second economic reward.
english.eep.30.name: An Irresistible Will
english.eep.30.desc:
Our lawful psionic ascension is complete. The court's consciousness reaches across the core; psionic coordination and normal jobs sustain its growing heart.

Vivhite regards alien echoes in the Shroud as worthless residue. There is no need to understand them. Only to make them submit to the end.

This moment records vanilla ascension already achieved. It grants no extra population, capacity or ascension eligibility.
english.eep.31.name: Stars Forged into Blades
english.eep.31.desc:
Our crisis progression has unlocked mineral ships. Devoured minerals feed the fleet while alloys sustain core construction; war closes both production loops.

Vivhite watches the fleet pass overhead. Losses can be replaced. Hesitation is forbidden.

Ship availability, costs and later stages follow vanilla rules. The Queen bypasses no DLC, ascension or special project requirement.
english.eep.31.a: Point the blade at the next world.
english.eep.40.name: Throne Disconnected
english.eep.40.desc:
Control of the bound core has been interrupted. Digestion stops and unsettled rewards remain sealed.

Vivhite's order is cold and direct. Recover it. The cost is irrelevant.

Recovering the same core resumes tasks. Moving the capital cannot create a second heart.
english.eep.40.a: Recover the throne at any cost.
english.eep.41.name: The Throne Restored
english.eep.41.desc:
The original homeworld is under our control again. Surviving digestion colonies resume progress; each pending task settles once against its own receipt.

Vivhite does not celebrate. Continue. Make them pay for the delay with everything they have.
english.eep.42.name: The Heart Stops
english.eep.42.desc:
The original homeworld is no longer a usable colony. The Heart of Devouring has no replacement throne.

Unfinished tasks end. There is no capital rebinding, copied capacity or replacement population. Surviving colonies continue under vanilla rules. The Queen's final order still leaves no room for mercy.
english.eep.100.name: Queen Vivhite: Court Ledger
english.eep.100.desc:
I count only what has returned to the throne.

english.eep.101.name: Digestion Colony: [eep_report_source.GetName]
english.eep.101.desc:
Destruction is no excuse. Account for your progress.

english.eep_path_generic: Generic dismantling: population from cumulative matter
english.eep.32.name: The Court’s Next Blade
english.eep.32.desc:
Vivhite examines the newly unlocked hull. Their resistance must end sooner than that of the last world.

Actual Nemesis stage: [Root.eep_crisis]. Stage 3 unlocks $crisis_destroyer$; stage 4 unlocks $crisis_cruiser$. Hulls, fitting and upkeep remain vanilla. This message grants no ability or reward.
english.eep_court_desc: The Queen's throne increases homeworld job output: +10% base, plus 10 percentage points per native Nemesis crisis level. Levels 1–5 yield 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% / 60%, synchronized by the next monthly update. The bonus follows the throne. Existing saves without this crisis retain the base 10%.
english.decision_eep_digest_report_desc: Present this world's stripping progress. Vivhite cares only for the value that has yet to reach her throne.
english.eep_digest_report_effect: View this world's devouring progress, pause reasons and pending settlement. The report grants no rewards.
english.decision_eep_auto_devour_enable_desc: The Queen commands every eligible colony except the bound homeworld to be devoured. Newly acquired colonies will also obey this order.
english.eep_auto_devour_enable_effect: Enable the empire-wide switch. Each month, begin devouring eligible owned worlds other than the bound homeworld, subject to founder seed, peace and core ownership requirements. Disabled by default; megastructures and other ineligible objects are skipped.
english.decision_eep_auto_devour_disable_desc: Suspend the throne's expansion order. Choose the fate of each world yourself.
english.eep_auto_devour_disable_effect: Disable automatic initiation of new tasks throughout the empire. Existing devouring tasks continue; cancel one through its source world's dismantling decision or its situation approach.
english.eep_parallel_construction_desc: The Queen commands one additional civilian construction project to advance simultaneously on the currently bound homeworld while under our control. This bonus follows the throne.
english.eep_mothership_desc: Relic-class dreadnought weapons, defenses and core technology, with a working jump drive, dark matter propulsion and ten mobile shipyards. Gains one uncapped evolution level per 10 matter consumed. Actual values depend on empire modifiers.
english.decision_eep_migrate_core_desc: Vivhite's will is not bound to soil. Establish this world as the new homeworld and move both the throne and imperial capital here.
english.eep_migration_required: The current homeworld must remain under our control. The destination must be an eligible owned colony, free of occupation and ground combat, neither artificial nor being devoured, and must not hold another throne.
english.eep_migration_effect: Move the homeworld binding, imperial capital, throne job bonus, accumulated district capacity and granted additional parallel construction queue here. Population, buildings, stockpiles and devouring ledgers are preserved. Other dismantling tasks continue and deliver their proceeds to the new homeworld. §RIf empire-wide automatic devouring is enabled, the former homeworld may subsequently be dismantled automatically.§!
english.decision_eep_cancel_devour_desc: Withdraw the order to dismantle this world. The Queen permits a changed command, but will not erase the costs already paid.
english.eep_cancel_devour_effect: Immediately abort this world's devouring situation and remove this Mod's dismantling locks, granting no rewards. Founder seed already relocated and native Terravore damage remain. Exempt this world from automatic devouring to prevent a restart next month; a resume decision or successful manual start removes the exemption. Other tasks and the empire-wide switch are preserved.
english.decision_eep_resume_auto_devour_desc: Revoke this world's temporary reprieve and return it to the empire's devouring command.
english.eep_resume_auto_devour_effect: Remove only this world's automatic-devouring exemption. If empire-wide automatic devouring is enabled, the next monthly scan attempts a normal start; otherwise a manual start is still required.
english.EEP_PLANET_KILLER_DEVOURER_DESC: Dismantles a natural colony for the homeworld without armies. Targets owned non-core colonies or enemy colonies during war. Completed firing grants capacity, population and mothership growth from effective world size. Generic dismantling creates 100 founder population per 6 matter; Terravores retain native random rewards. Cancelled shots grant nothing.
english.eep_colossus_target_required: Requires your mothership, an available homeworld, and an owned non-core or wartime enemy natural colony with more than 0 effective matter. Cannot target any empire's homeworld core, artificial worlds, ongoing colonization, ground battles, active devouring tasks or previously settled worlds.
english.eep_mothership_evolution_desc: Gain one evolution level per 10 cumulative effective matter, with no level cap. Each level adds +5% damage, hull, armor and shields, plus 0.1 daily hull and armor regeneration.
english.eep_evolution_report: Mothership evolution level: [Root.eep_mothership_level]; matter to next level: [Root.eep_mothership_next]. Each level adds +5% damage, hull, armor and shields. One level per 10 matter, with no level cap.$eep_component_report$
english.EEP_ADAPTIVE_SHIELD_CORE_DESC: Each rank adds 10% shields. Every five evolution levels, one of six cores is chosen with equal probability and permanently gains one rank. This core adds no power or upkeep cost.
english.EEP_ADAPTIVE_ARMOR_CORE_DESC: Each rank adds 10% armor. Every five evolution levels, one of six cores is chosen with equal probability and permanently gains one rank. This core adds no power or upkeep cost.
english.EEP_ADAPTIVE_HULL_CORE_DESC: Each rank adds 10% hull. Every five evolution levels, one of six cores is chosen with equal probability and permanently gains one rank. This core adds no power or upkeep cost.
english.EEP_ADAPTIVE_DAMAGE_CORE_DESC: Each rank adds 5% weapon damage. Every five evolution levels, one of six cores is chosen with equal probability and permanently gains one rank. This core adds no power or upkeep cost.
english.EEP_ADAPTIVE_TRACKING_CORE_DESC: Each rank adds 3 tracking points. Every five evolution levels, one of six cores is chosen with equal probability and permanently gains one rank. This core adds no power or upkeep cost.
english.EEP_ADAPTIVE_REGEN_CORE_DESC: Each rank adds 0.2 fixed daily hull and 0.2 armor regeneration. Every five evolution levels, one of six cores is chosen with equal probability and permanently gains one rank. This core adds no power or upkeep cost.
english.eep_component_report:
§HCore Upgrade Record§!
Entitled: [Root.eep_component_entitled]; awarded: [Root.eep_component_rewards]; pending: [Root.eep_component_pending]
Last confirmed ranks: shields [Root.eep_component_shield_level] / armor [Root.eep_component_armor_level] / hull [Root.eep_component_hull_level] / firepower [Root.eep_component_damage_level] / tracking [Root.eep_component_tracking_level] / regeneration [Root.eep_component_regen_level].
Every five levels permanently upgrades one of six cores at random. Large backlogs are awarded in batches. Upgrades stop if the mothership is destroyed or unavailable; its history is retained and does not represent active components. Zero is shown if no record exists.
